review.summary: Single quiet-scoring predicate switches cached direct-check squares to the existing const gives_check predicate (including discovered and applicable special-move checks). Generated moves satisfy its structural assertions; legal move filtering is unchanged. Existing see_ge(-75) treats special moves as zero and thus admits them. No ownership, sharing, or indexing change or identified UB. General across openings. Additional checks on quiet moves may cost NPS; measure on control suite and clocked paired runs. Source-only approval for screening; no strength claim.

explanation: Passed source review, UCI checks, perft and reproducibility. Local panel EXP-ADVERSARIAL-001 owns match outcomes; no public testing or promotion.
hypothesis: The existing quiet-check ordering bonus can recognize useful discovered checks and special checking moves that direct destination-square masks miss. Earlier ordering may save search when these quiet moves force a reply.
